sections.label: Sound and sustainable finances
sections.summary: MOF will allocate resources judiciously, keep taxes and transfers fair and progressive, spend within its means, and steward reserves responsibly.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) will allocate resources judiciously and evaluate programmes rigorously, to maintain sound and sustainable finances.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Our system of taxes and transfers will remain fair and progressive: everyone contributes and the better off contribute more, and everyone benefits and those with greater needs receive more.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: With rising needs, Government spending in this term will increase as a share of gross domestic product.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to spend within its means and maintain a balanced budget over the medium term.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will continue to steward our reserves responsibly.

sections.label: Economic resilience and competitiveness
sections.summary: The Singapore Economic Resilience Taskforce and Economic Strategy Review will work with agencies and stakeholders to navigate uncertainties and keep Singapore competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Through the Singapore Economic Resilience Taskforce and the Economic Strategy Review, we will work with agencies and stakeholders to navigate global uncertainties and keep Singapore competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will continue to invest in our productive capacity – helping businesses, especially small and medium-sized enterprises, to innovate and harness AI and other technologies, and supporting Singaporeans to reskill and upskill through SkillsFuture.

sections.label: Forward Singapore major moves
sections.summary: Forward Singapore introduced the Majulah Package, a new public housing framework, new SkillsFuture programmes, and initiatives for a family-friendly Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Under Forward Singapore, we introduced major moves – the Majulah Package to strengthen retirement adequacy, a new public housing framework to improve affordability, new SkillsFuture programmes to uplift workers and initiatives to encourage a family-friendly Singapore.
